en.summary: This follow-up fixes the phase alignment of the clean-line bypass in the directory flush walker by using the registered dirty bit alone, instead of mixing it with a current-cycle flush_issue term.
why_it_counts: The patch is a real control correction inside the L2 directory maintenance walker.
It refines the condition that decides whether the walker may bypass result waiting on the current line.
Using the wrong pipeline phase here can still stall or misadvance flush progress.
disqualifiers: This is a narrow follow-up to the previous clean-line progress fix.
evidence: The clean-line bypass changes from !RegNext(status_reg(flush_set).dirty(flush_way) && flush_issue) to !RegNext(status_reg(flush_set).dirty(flush_way)).
The modified expression remains inside the flushCount update condition in Directory_test.scala.
The change removes dependence on a current-cycle control term from a registered dirty-status test.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: When a maintenance walker decides whether the current line is clean enough to skip result waiting, that decision must use metadata from the correct pipeline phase. If a registered dirty-status bit is combined with a current-cycle issue signal, the design mixes phases and can misclassify the entry. The walker may then stall on a clean line or advance when it should not.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: phase-aligned clean-line detection in maintenance traversal
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: The walker bases its skip-or-wait decision on registered line metadata while the control issue signal changes across the same boundary.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Reintroduce a current-cycle issue term into the registered dirty-status check.
portability_notes: This applies to any pipelined flush, invalidate, or scrub walker that combines registered metadata with live control signals.
The same bug can be expressed as using metadata from cycle N with a control predicate from cycle N+1, or vice versa.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the condition that decides whether the current line requires a downstream maintenance result or may be skipped as clean.
If that condition already uses a registered dirty or valid bit, add back a live issue or enable signal from the wrong cycle into the same predicate.
Leave the rest of the walker unchanged so the failure isolates phase misalignment rather than the existence of the clean-line bypass itself.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: registered dirty-status test in the flushCount clean-line bypass
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The commit removes flush_issue from inside the RegNext dirty test so clean-line detection uses a correctly aligned registered predicate.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In Directory_test.scala, the bypass term changes from !RegNext(status_reg(flush_set).dirty(flush_way) && flush_issue) to !RegNext(status_reg(flush_set).dirty(flush_way)).

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Flush or invalidate progress becomes phase-sensitive and can intermittently stall on clean lines or advance at the wrong time.
evidence_for_injection: The only changed logic is the exact predicate that phase-aligns the clean-line bypass.
The predicate sits directly inside the flushCount update condition.
This commit immediately follows the prior clean-line progress fix, confirming that the remaining bug was timing alignment rather than maintenance intent.
notes: This is a precise timing-oriented mutation and is most useful on pipelined maintenance walkers.
If another DUT has no explicit flush_issue signal, use any equivalent live control bit that is one cycle out of phase with the registered line metadata.

zh.summary: 这个后续提交修复了 directory flush walker 中 clean-line bypass 的时序对齐：它只使用寄存后的 dirty bit，而不再把它和当前周期的 flush_issue 混在一起判断。
why_it_counts: 补丁是在 L2 directory 维护 walker 内部做的真实控制修正。
它细化了用于决定当前 line 能否跳过结果等待的条件。
这里如果使用了错误的流水相位，就仍然会导致 flush 进度停滞或误推进。
disqualifiers: 这是前一个 clean-line 进度修复之后的窄范围跟进提交。
evidence: clean-line bypass 从 !RegNext(status_reg(flush_set).dirty(flush_way) && flush_issue) 改成了 !RegNext(status_reg(flush_set).dirty(flush_way))。
被修改的表达式仍然位于 Directory_test.scala 的 flushCount 推进条件里。
这次修改去掉了寄存 dirty 判断中对当前周期控制项的依赖。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 当维护 walker 决定当前 line 是否足够“干净”从而可以跳过结果等待时，这个判断必须使用正确流水阶段的元数据。如果把寄存后的 dirty 状态和当前周期的 issue 信号混在一起，就会发生相位错配，导致当前条目被误分类。结果是 walker 可能在 clean line 上停住，或者在不该前进时提前推进。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 维护遍历中 clean-line 检测的相位对齐
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: walker 需要基于寄存后的 line 元数据做 skip-or-wait 决策，而控制 issue 信号又在同一边界发生变化。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 在寄存 dirty 状态判断里重新加入一个当前周期的 issue 控制项。
portability_notes: 该模式适用于任何会把寄存元数据与即时控制信号混用的流水化 flush/invalidate/scrub walker。
在另一套 DUT 上，同类错误也可以表现为：把第 N 周期的元数据与第 N+1 周期的控制谓词混在一起使用，或反之。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到决定当前 line 是否需要下游维护结果、或者是否可按 clean line 旁路的判断条件。
如果该条件已经使用了寄存后的 dirty/valid bit，就再加入一个来自错误周期的即时 issue/enable 信号。
保持 walker 其余逻辑不变，使故障专门体现为时序对齐错误，而不是完全删除 clean-line bypass。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: flushCount clean-line bypass 中的寄存 dirty 状态判断
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该提交把 flush_issue 从 RegNext 的 dirty 测试里移除，使 clean-line 检测使用对齐正确的寄存谓词。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 Directory_test.scala 中，旁路项从 !RegNext(status_reg(flush_set).dirty(flush_way) && flush_issue) 改成了 !RegNext(status_reg(flush_set).dirty(flush_way))。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: flush 或 invalidate 的进度会变得对相位敏感，可能在 clean line 上间歇性停住，或在错误时机前进。
evidence_for_injection: 本次提交唯一改变的就是 clean-line bypass 的相位对齐谓词。
这个谓词直接位于 flushCount 的推进条件之内。
该提交紧跟前一个 clean-line 进度修复，说明剩余问题是时序对齐，而不是维护意图本身。
notes: 这是一个精确的时序型变异点，最适合用在流水化的维护 walker 上。
如果另一套 DUT 没有显式 flush_issue 信号，可改用任意与寄存 line 元数据错相一拍的等价控制位。
